opis: A sunny PICNIC on the green grass by the blue lake from the reference picture, the little red engine on the rails behind and the wooden pier on the lake. The MOLE, the BEAR and the OWL sit on a red-and-white checked blanket, laughing; an open little backpack lies on the blanket and in front of it EXACTLY FIVE things are laid out in a row: one red apple, one sandwich, one cap, one ball, one small picture book. On the water near the shore a mother duck swims with her yellow ducklings; the bear holds out a piece of bread to them. Warm morning light, a joyful day out.
